name: quiz-builder
description: Quiz Builder: NestJS + Prisma backend, Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @quiz/shared dev" "pnpm --filter backend start:dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @quiz/shared build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter backend prisma:deploy && pnpm --filter backend prisma:generate
